item.description:
• OpenCode is recognised properly now. Your Kit could already connect to it, but the card kept saying it was not installed and offered you a download link for something you already had. It now sees what is on your Mac.
  • AnythingLLM is recognised the same way, for the same reason.
  • The rest of the OpenCode work from earlier today comes with it: OpenCode as a place your Kit lives, and OpenCode Zen as a provider your Kit can think with, under Settings then Models.
